name: burstTokenWithValidOptionWithoutArg
expected: tokens list contains "-a" and currentOption becomes the option 'a'

name: burstTokenWithValidOptionHavingArgAndRemainingChars
input: token="-bval", stopAtNonOption=false (where options has 'b' with an argument)
expected: tokens list contains "-b" and "val", and loop terminates

name: burstTokenWithValidOptionHavingArgNoRemainingChars
input: token="-b", stopAtNonOption=false (where options has 'b' with an argument)
expected: tokens list contains "-b" and currentOption becomes 'b', remaining characters length equals (i + 1) so no argument token is added immediately

name: burstTokenWithMultipleValidNonArgOptions
input: token="-ac", stopAtNonOption=false (where options has 'a' and 'c' both without args)
expected: tokens list contains "-a" and "-c", iterating through both characters

name: burstTokenWithUnknownOptionAndStopAtNonOptionTrue
input: token="-x", stopAtNonOption=true (where options does not have 'x')
expected: calls process("x"), which sets eatTheRest=true and adds "--" and "x" to tokens list

name: burstTokenWithUnknownOptionAndStopAtNonOptionFalse
input: token="-x", stopAtNonOption=false (where options does not have 'x')
expected: adds the entire token "-x" to the tokens list and breaks

name: burstTokenWithMixedValidAndUnknownOptionStopTrue
expected: adds "-a", then hits 'x' with stopAtNonOption=true, calls process("x") adding "--" and "x"

name: burstTokenWithMixedValidAndUnknownOptionStopFalse
expected: adds "-a", then hits 'x' with stopAtNonOption=false, adds the entire token "-ax" to tokens and breaks

name: burstTokenWithValidOptionWithArgFollowedByAnotherChar
input: token="-bc", stopAtNonOption=false ('b' has arg, 'c' is next char)
expected: adds "-b", then adds "c" as the argument for 'b' because remaining characters exist, and breaks

name: burstTokenWithOnlyHyphenBoundary
expected: loop condition i < token.length() (1 < 1) is false, so tokens list remains unchanged

name: burstTokenWithUnknownOptionContainingMultipleCharsStopTrue
expected: hits 'x' (unknown), stopAtNonOption is true, calls process("xyz") adding "--" and "xyz" to tokens

name: burstTokenWithUnknownOptionContainingMultipleCharsStopFalse
expected: hits 'x' (unknown), stopAtNonOption is false, adds the entire token "-xyz" to tokens and breaks
